environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway REST API with a regional WAF WebACL attached. The WebACL includes a custom rule group 'template-request-sanitizer' with priority 1 that evaluates query string parameters using a regex pattern set named 'path-segment-patterns' containing entries for encoded and literal directory traversal sequences. The rule group action is set to BLOCK with custom response code 403. pgBouncer is configured in session mode with server_lifetime=300 and application_name_add_host=1, using prepared statements exclusively through extended query protocol (PARSE messages). The database role used by pgBouncer has SELECT-only grants on the templates and access_log tables via a PostgreSQL security definer function wrapper, meaning INSERT to access_log goes through a SECURITY DEFINER function owned by a privileged role. The Lambda execution role has a permission boundary policy that denies s3:GetObject and ssm:GetParameter to prevent credential exfiltration even if code execution is achieved through other means.

config.api_gateway: REST API, proxy integration, regional WAF WebACL attached
config.pgbouncer: session mode, server_lifetime=300, extended query protocol only
config.db_role: SELECT on templates via security definer function, INSERT to access_log via security definer function
config.network: Lambda in private subnet, pgBouncer on EC2 in same VPC
